description: Per-container conditional visibility. isHidden toggles the WHOLE container off; the Condition's LHSType tells you what it is testing — DatasourceParameter for live repeater-row data, PageVariable for a page Variable (e.g. the tab-switch pattern).
notes: Two confirmed LHSType values, testing genuinely different things: DatasourceParameter reads a live repeater-row/datasource field (dot-path "item.<field>", same root as variable_ref.json); PageVariable reads a page-level Variable by NAME directly (no dot-path, no "item." prefix).

The tab-switch pattern is exactly Condition_Sample02's shape repeated once per tab pane, each with a different RHSValue matching one tab's identifier, paired with an EventMapping on each tab button that calls kf.app.page.setVariable("sampleActiveTab", "<that pane's value>") on click — no dedicated Tabs-with-Criteria capture beyond this generic pattern was needed since the two mechanisms (Criteria and EventMapping) are each independently confirmed and simply compose.

This is a DIFFERENT Criteria usage from FieldValidation-owned Criteria on the process side (a MIN_LENGTH/MAX_LENGTH string-length rule on a form field, keyed by "FieldValidation" instead of "Container", with no LHSVariable/LHSType/LHSDataType at all) — same Kind name, different owner key, different purpose, different Condition shape. Do not conflate them.
